name: inspect_firmware_regions
description: Inspect signature candidates in a local firmware file with Binwalk 3.1.x (verified with 3.1.0). Returns offsets, reported lengths, descriptions and raw confidence values. Length validation and runtime addresses remain unknown. No extraction or target execution. Linux, caller-supplied tool, util-linux prlimit and procps ps required; 128 MiB input limit, one worker. Adjust analysis_timeout_ms for the analysis wall-clock budget (default 120000); fixed per-process limits are unchanged.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

analysis_timeout_ms.description: Analysis wall-clock budget in milliseconds (default 120000), from tool resolution through inspection and its final workspace cleanup, or extraction through inventory. Excludes queue admission and extraction publication. Does not raise fixed CPU, memory or byte limits.

path.description: Absolute local firmware file; never executed. Relative paths are rejected.
